newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing earlier gain.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing earlier gain.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday, after selling by local investors erased earlier price gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 100 yen lower to 10 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract down 90 yen at 15,860 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 32,379 lots.
Light buying from individual investors supported all months at the opening, traders said, but the yen's firmer tone against the dollar triggered selling by the afternoon session.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.01-3/4 per bushel at 0800 GMT, unchanged from Tueday's close.
The spot May of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.41-1/2 at 0800 GMT, up from $8.40-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
